description: Fires when column 1's landing cell (bottom, second or top row) would complete a horizontal or diagonal four, mainly for the opponent (a must-block), e.g. O on 2,3,4 of the bottom row with column 1 empty (activation 20-35); also for my own win there. Weaker (2-12): any must-block early in the game (about 10 stones or fewer), fading as the board fills. Vertical column-1 threats and threats in the three middle rows of column 1 do not count.
effect: Pushes the model to play column 1: forcing it high in quiet positions moves about +0.9 probability to column 1, mostly taken from column 3. Turning it off in a forced column-1 block changes nothing, so other paths also carry the block.
notes: Best dev F1 0.422 (P 0.49, R 0.37, AUROC 0.68), p5. Col-1 rule alone had precision 0.82 but recall 0.20. Any must-block: precision 0.10. Adding early-game must-blocks (ply<=10) raised F1 to 0.42. Act minimal pairs: threat removed gives ~0; a second must-block elsewhere drops it from 20-30 to 3-4; vertical col-1 threes give negative values; same vertical threat decays with ply (11.7->1.1 from ply 8 to 14). About 60% of firing is just above threshold (0.98-1.3) with no visible pattern, which caps recall. Simulation share is strongly negative for every program tried (unexplained). Synthesis reaches 34.98 vs dev max 35.25.
